sources.title: Bank SinoPac completes acquisition of 80 per cent of Amret
sources.locator: Announcement opening paragraph; completion date and 80% stake.

sources.title: Bank SinoPac Plans to Acquire Amret, one of the leading financial institutions in Cambodia, to Expand Overseas Business and Broaden Its Positive Influence on Sustainable Finance
sources.locator: Second and fourth paragraphs; calls Amret Cambodia’s largest microfinance deposit-taking institution by total assets and states its total assets as of 2023-12-31.

sources.title: 永豐金併購案連三發 營運版圖再下一城 永豐金證券董事會通過以現金16.28億台幣 吸收合併台灣匯立證券
sources.effective_period: SinoPac says Amret’s first-stage 80% equity closing was completed early in 2025
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning “永豐金及子公司永豐銀行分別於2024年12月及2024年5月”; says Amret completed the first-stage 80% equity closing early that year and joined operations.

sources.title: Bank SinoPac Group

已完成多輪聚焦檢索；交易及首階段交割可核實，但未找到能同時明確限定2025期間、微型金融市場範圍及排名分母的資料來確認排名原子。
交易完成日期及80%首階段交割有Amret與永豐金控官方資料支持。
「柬埔寨第一大微型銀行」未明確限定市場分類或排名指標；找到的有日期排名資料以微型存款金融機構總資產為口徑，參考期截至2023年末，不能直接等同於2025年交割時的排名。
